name: Tenkasi, Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi region
author: SIVAH-AKASH
description:
Custom map of the Tenkasi, Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi region of Tamil Nadu, India with additional LCLU, railway, terrain and admin boundary layers.

The additional layers are all optional. To enable them, download the `TTT-mod-optional-vX.y.z.7z` file here: https://github.com/SIVAH-AKASH/Subway_Builder-TTT-map/releases and place in your mod folder.
